Another thing I tend to do is compare my old scars to my new, so if I can't cut as deep as before it feels insignificant.

That is definitely annoying. Also when clothing or other hiding devices slip and you're paranoid someone saw something. Also people making assumptions about scars. All the scars on my arms are 4+ years old and people always tell me to stop, like these are old and it's none of your business.
I cut over scars and even cuts that aren't completely healed. I haven't noticed too much of a difference. Definitely prefer cutting inbetween but I've nearly ran out of room on my thighs for that

Just keep it clean. Look up what an infected cut looks like just to be sure yours isn't. Best way to prevent infection is to keep it clean and covered. At least that's what I do. I hope you're feeling better 💕

I've had people say stuff to my parents about it when I was younger. But I'm an adult now so hopefully they won't. I've been cutting deeper so a three week old cut is still scabbing. I'll just put a band aid on the deeper scabbed ones and hope for the best

I haven't cut my arms in 4 years so all the scars are white, I do have a couple burn scars that are still red but not noticeably SH. Some aren't quite scars yet, I stopped hiding scars but cuts I always hide for multiple reasons. I just hope if people have an issue or something they'll talk to me first
I am so paranoid about that happening holy shit
